items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: He was the Levite amongst his, all the Shalang... But one time he played fine drums, man. He played with Sharky at the race. He played with Winging in Chicago.

ctx.x: Well, I heard some different stories about him.

He was lost for a long time. Nobody knew where he was. Then he came back to town. I tell you, Shalang, I mean, what's the name of my Sharky? You tell yourself. Sharky only used three drummers, man, all the time. He was the Levite amongst his, all the Shalang. Sharky and Shalang were like that. I was surprised, when all he come back, that he didn't play with Sharky anymore. At all. Now, he couldn't play anymore, either. I tell you, I tell you. But one time he played fine drums, man. He played with Winging in Chicago, that one.
